name: Spiral Plate Heat Exchanger
full_description: ViEX describes itself as a professional domestic manufacturer of spiral plate heat exchangers with advanced design schemes, rich manufacturing experience, advanced tooling equipment, and wide application fields. The official page lists both detachable and non-detachable spiral plate heat exchangers, gives material and channel options, and highlights innovative results such as crude benzol condensers, four-channel detachable spiral plate heat exchangers, and one-side detachable spiral plate heat exchangers.
advantage: Advanced design scheme and rich manufacturing experience
Wide range of material and size options
Suitable for demanding industrial process applications
Includes export and steel, coking, alcohol, and biotech references

details.title: What innovative results are listed?
details.content: The official page lists crude benzol condensers, four-channel detachable spiral plate heat exchangers, and one-side detachable spiral plate heat exchangers as representative innovative results.

details.title: What reference projects are shown?
details.content: The page cites Baosteel Meishan coking, Tangshan Ganglu Steel, the Usiminas project in Brazil, Jiyuan Jinma Coking, Jilin Xintianlong Alcohol, Heilongjiang Xiangyuan Oil Factory, and export-related cases among typical references.
